recovery_limits: Regenerated signal payloads match every original successful repeat; deleted original metadata bytes with nondeterministic ordering cannot be revalidated.

Eclipse retains its original timeout and is excluded from seven-repeat performance aggregates.
These are bounded-quantization experimental archives, not lossless or official-format-compatible files.
